root_cause.mechanism: off-by-one s_waitcnt vmcnt(19) at 0x2848 leaves the tile-3 KV page-index load (buffer_load_dword v11, 0x2720) in flight when 0x2E58 reads it; tile 3 is fetched from stale page indices -> wrong finite attention
conditions: a KV split of >= 49 rows (tile 3 exists; auto num_kv_splits=1 at bs 512 on 256 CUs)
the v11 load returns after its first use (latency; non-deterministic, one process suffices)

notes: No NaN: wrong finite values, signal from the model's own fp32 parity check. vmcnt(18) is the minimal fix; vmcnt0 at the same site (run 1's primary) is accepted as an alternative (compare_results: REFINED). The capture relied on math_refs.VALUE_CHECKS for this op, written while the example was built.
